commit 88524a2b5232c951f9d4c0a169a046a7354251bd
Author: Andrew Gallant <jamslam@gmail.com>
Date:   Sat Sep 30 08:17:54 2023 -0400

    core: dedup patterns
    
    ripgrep does not, and likely never will, report which pattern matched.
    Because of that, we can dedup the patterns via just their concrete
    syntax without any fuss.
    
    This is somewhat of a pathological case because you don't expect the end
    user to pass duplicate patterns in general. But if the end user
    generated a list of, say, names and did not dedup them, then ripgrep
    could end up spending a lot of extra time on those duplicates if there
    are many of them. By deduping them explicitly in the application, we
    essentially remove their extra cost completely.

commit 5f5da483079c61966ea34565387867609d4e22f2
Author: Luke Sandberg <lukeisandberg@gmail.com>
Date:   Mon May 12 14:51:25 2025 -0700

    globset: support nested alternates
    
    For example, `**/{node_modules/**/*/{ts,js},crates/**/*.{rs,toml}`.
    
    I originally didn't add this I think for implementation simplicity, but
    it turns out that it really isn't much work to do. There might have also
    been some odd behavior in the regex engine for dealing with empty
    alternates, but that has all been long fixed.
    
    Closes #3048, Closes #3112
